item.title: 🔵 Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
item.description:
Why this matters: Endpoint detection changes — review high-severity detections and alert noise.
Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 1h ago
